summary_en: Major porphyry Cu-Mo-Ag deposit in central Peru. One of the world's highest altitude copper mines at 4,500m.
Porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in southern Peru. Includes Pampacancha satellite pit.
Porphyry-skarn Cu-Au deposit near Tintaya. Replaced the historic Tintaya mine.
Large undeveloped porphyry Cu-Mo deposit. Primary and secondary enrichment zones.
Undeveloped porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in the Apurimac belt. Feasibility study underway.
Undeveloped porphyry Cu-Au-Mo deposit. Part of the Cajamarca mining district.
Large undeveloped porphyry Cu deposit. Rio Tinto acquired in 2006. High altitude.
Porphyry Cu-Au deposit. Preliminary economic assessment completed. Significant gold credits.
Cu-Mo skarn deposit in the Cordillera Blanca. Exploration stage.
Porphyry Cu-Au-Mo deposit. Feasibility study completed 2019.
Porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in the Apurimac porphyry belt.
Satellite skarn deposit at Las Bambas. Development planned as part of Las Bambas expansion.
Sediment-hosted Cu-Ag-Mn deposit. Unique polymetallic mineralization style.
Porphyry Cu-Mo deposit in the Yarabamba district of southern Peru.
Porphyry Cu-Au deposit in northern Peru. Large tonnage low-grade system.
